name: Campbellsville University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university in Campbellsville, KY, affiliated with the Kentucky Baptist Convention. Offers a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs with a liberal arts core. Emphasizes small class sizes and faith-based education. (Specific national ranking not confirmed from official pages during research.)
financial_aid: University states it is committed to affordable, accessible education. Aid includes federal Pell Grants (up to $7,395/yr), Direct/PLUS loans, SEOG, Federal Work-Study; Kentucky state aid via KHEAA (KY Tuition Grant up to $3,300/yr, CAP Grant up to $5,300/yr for KY residents); and merit-based scholarships and need-based grants administered through the AwardSpring system. FAFSA and Net Price Calculator available. Source: campbellsville.edu financial aid page, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball program plays at Campbellsville University. Specific field/stadium name and facility details were not confirmed from official athletics pages during research (softball landing page checked 2026-07; facilities not detailed).
program_reputation: Competes in NAIA within the Mid-South Conference. Team carried a '(RV)' (Receiving Votes) designation in national rankings per the athletics site navigation as of 2026-07, indicating a competitive program that is nationally noticed but not top-ranked. Detailed recent record and standings not confirmed from official pages during research.
notes: Data gathered from official athletics site (campbellsvilletigers.com) softball coaches and roster pages and the university financial aid/tuition pages, checked 2026-07. Tuition reflects 2026-2027 Campbellsville Campus flat rate (12-18 hrs) of $14,880/semester = $29,760/year (prior 2025-2026 year was $28,618/year). Roster size counted at 30 players. No individual coach Twitter/X handles were publicly listed; team X account is @CvilleLTS. Scholarship count not publicly listed.
